title: Latency Decoupling in Low-Feedback Multi-User Networks via Overhearing-Driven NOMA
summary: Conventional wireless protocols such as Hybrid Automatic Repeat Request (HARQ) rely on frequent and timely feedback, which becomes impractical in low-feedback regimes including non-terrestrial networks and massive IoT. This limitation is particularly critical in heterogeneous multi-user systems with unknown and asymmetric channels, where a single weak user can dominate the overall completion latency.
